name: sim_ac2_mercedes_standings_priority
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli.
User: How did Mercedes do recently and where do we stand in the championship?
Agent Action: Call Tool get_driver_standings with args {'category': 'all', 'season': 2026.0}
Agent: According to the latest-available 2026 data, Mercedes-AMG Petronas is leading the Constructors' Championship in first place with 538 points. Kimi Antonelli is currently in first place in the drivers' standings with 302 points, and George Russell is right behind him in second place with 236 points. Recently, George won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, following a fantastic one-two finish for the team at Monza.
User: That is fantastic news, thank you for the update!
Agent: You are very welcome! It is a brilliant season for the Silver Arrows so far, and we are all cheering for George and Kimi to keep this momentum going. Please let me know if you would like the schedule for the next race or any other team updates!
